Software Engineering

Time: 3 Hours Answer ALL Questions Max. Marks: 60
Part-A (10 x i= 10 Marks)

List the types of other software process models.
List the types of software myths.

Explain functional requirements.

Explain user requirements in detail.

List kinds of behavioural and object models.
Explain requirement review.

Describe white box testing.

Distinguish between testing and debugging.
What is FTR?

Define risk components.

Part-B (5 x 1 0= 50 Marks)

Explain “Evolutionary Process Flow” with a neat sketch.
Explain in detail about Scrum.

OR
Explain framework activities with a neat diagram.
Explain briefly the Generic Process Model.

How requirements are classified? List them with an example for
each.
Classify the following as functional /non-functional
requirements for a banking system.

i. Verifying bank balance

ii. Withdrawing money from a bank

iii. Completion of transactions in less than one second.

iv. Extending the system by providing more tellers for the

customers

OR

Analyze the requirement engineering process and how
the requirements are managed.
What is requirement elicitation? Briefly describe the various
activities performed in requirements elicitation with an example of
a watch system that facilitates setting time and alarm and
assessment.

Analyze briefly the structural system analysis in detail.
What is the purpose of data flow diagrams? What are the notations
used for the same?

OR
Develop an online railway reservation system, which allows the
user to select book/cancel tickets using net banking/credit/debit
cards.
Draw and explain the use case diagram for an ATM system
in requirement elicitation.
